title: Small-family exterior weight bound
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\epsilon,\eta\in\mathbb{R}$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of its real-valued version over sets outside the improved Friedgut small family is at most the sum over sets outside the improved Friedgut family plus the sum over coordinate sets of size greater than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
